name: The Coastline
author: Second Credit
description: Five islands to hold, one after the other, each for a few rounds more than the last.

intro.title: The Coastline
intro.text:
The fleet has been sighted off the coast. The old castles are still standing, but the walls between them are long gone.
Pick a castle, raise the walls, place your cannons. Hold First Shore for three rounds, and we sail on.

story.title: Twin Coves
story.text:
First Shore held. The fleet slipped round the headland to the twin coves, where two bays give their ships two ways in.
Hold it four rounds. Mind both beaches.

story.title: The Narrows
story.text:
Two lobes of land and a thin neck of sand between them. Whoever holds the neck holds the island, and the fleet knows it.
Five rounds.

story.title: Rock Garden
story.text:
Nothing grows here but stone. The rocks will not take a wall, so plan every piece around them.
Five rounds, and the ships are getting bolder.

story.title: Last Light
story.text:
The last island before open sea, with its lighthouse still burning. Five castles, and every one of them worth keeping.
Hold it six rounds and the fleet turns for home.

outro.title: The Fleet Turns
outro.text:
On the sixth night the sails on the horizon turn away, one by one, until the sea is empty.
The lighthouse keeper climbs down for the first time in a week. The walls can wait until morning.
